4-1/2 x 4  Aluminum Store Front Door Hinges

text.description_html:
4 1/2" x 4" x Square Corners Commercial Store Front Door Hinge

For Aluminum Frame Store Front Doors. Heavy duty steel commercial grade door hinge with 2 ball bearings.

Specifications:

  • Height: 4-1/2"
  • Width: 4"
  • Corners: Square
  • Thickness: 0.134"
  • 2 Ball Bearings for Smooth Action
  • US26D Brushed Chrome Finish
  • Standard Template Hole Pattern
  • Steel Hinge Pin
  • Non-Rising Removable Pin
  • Button Tip Pin and Plug
  • Conforms to ANSI A8112 for Ball Bearing

Package with matching finish 12-24 x 1/2" machine screws and 12 x 1-1/4" wood screws.

*Sold Individually



** Item Discontinued, use 4-1/2 x 4 Non-Removable Pin Hinge, Brushed Chrome
